blurb:
“The Key West Cocktail Cruise is the best thing to happen to Sunsets since cameras and sunglasses!”

This is not your average Key West pleasure cruise.  

Our 2 hour Key West Cocktail Cruise is what happens when true Hospitality Professionals take you out for an evening on the water!  You’ll never find Sierra Mist in our Margaritas — just natural ingredients, hand-crafted to perfection and served with precision.

"All Inclusive" Craft Beer, Fine Wine and of course Craft Cocktails are featured each night onboard our spacious 47’ catamaran.  We offer a full range of House Specialty Cocktails, California Wines, and South Florida Craft Beer. Our intention is to amaze our guests with 5-star service, and to offer a fresh and unique Sunset Experience every single evening!
